title: transit config: GcConfig.schedule is a free string, never validated
description: transit/src/config.rs GcConfig.schedule is a String with no cron-expression validation. The GcConfig struct has an #[allow(dead_code)] attribute indicating it is read but not yet consumed. When GC is implemented and begins parsing this field, any existing deployed config with a typo (e.g. '0 3 * *' missing a field) will fail at runtime rather than at startup. Maintenance consequence: the config format will fossilize without ever being validated; operators will discover malformed cron expressions only when GC silently fails to run.
